design: Tall slender adult patrol sentinel. Slate-grey narrow skull with four visible slim mandibles, smooth long cranial ridge, long tightly bound dreadlocks in a high rear queue. Lightweight fitted black lamellar vest, narrow square bronze shoulder caps, pale grey wrap collar, long asymmetrical hip flap over one thigh, narrow segmented greaves. A narrow folded spear rests diagonally against the right shoulder held loosely, compact disc pouch on left hip. Feet close in poised alert stance.
